 Aion 2: Server down – Everything about the server maintenance and the patch notes on November 11, 2026 in the live ticker
 Karsten Scholz 
 11. November 2026 
 Reading time 
 < 1 minutes 
 Add MeinMMO to your Google favorites 
 On November 11, 2026, there will be server maintenance at Aion 2 . The realms will therefore be offline for a while. MeinMMO will be live to observe when you can play again. 
 Wednesday, November 11, 2026
 08:14 AM
 The update is now available for download. It is 3.8 GB in size.
 07:30 AM
 The servers are offline.
 06:30 AM
 Good morning, dear Daevas! Today there will be server maintenance:
 Date: November 11, 2026
 Time: 07:30 AM CET
 Duration: approximately 4 hours 30 minutes
 So log out early so you won’t be unceremoniously kicked out.
 We will be live for you 
 When will the servers go offline? Maintenance will start at 07:30 AM CET on November 11, 2026.
 What will happen then? From that point on, you will not be able to play anymore and will be kicked out of the game. During maintenance, you will also not be able to reconnect.
 How long is the maintenance supposed to last? For Europe, a maintenance duration of 4 hours and 30 minutes is scheduled, as NCSoft states on the official website . The servers should be reachable again from 12:00 PM. However, the developers point out that there may also be changes.
 Aion 2: Patch Notes for the Update on November 11, 2026
 Are there already patch notes? No, not yet. We will update this section as soon as NCSoft releases the patch notes for November 11, 2026.
